subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: What restore-safe native backup exclusion surface should OpenClaw core support for `openclaw backup create` while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 is open?
rationale: Default exclusions, protected backup paths, and sensitive-file filtering affect restore completeness and security boundaries, so automation should not choose the final policy while an open implementation candidate already exists.

options.title: Native Exclude Controls
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a narrower replacement as the implementation path after resolving conflicts, proof, compatibility, and protected-path semantics.

options.title: Minimal Reliability First
options.body: Ship only completion/error/progress improvements now and leave general exclude-pattern policy for a later design decision.

options.title: Document Plugin Boundary
options.body: Document current core backup limits and route advanced backup policy to ClawHub only if maintainers decide native exclusions are outside core.

recommendation.title: Native Exclude Controls
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a narrower replacement as the implementation path after resolving conflicts, proof, compatibility, and protected-path semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product and security policy for a stable CLI surface, and steipete has recent adjacent docs/test routing history for this area.
